basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Bhubaneswar Project Technical Support-III Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

age_limit.details: The maximum age limit for the post is 35 years. | Cut-off date for the age limit will be the date of the Walk-In-Interview, i.e., 31/10/2026.

qualification.details: Desirable Qualifications: Prior hands-on experience in the pathology/biochemistry /blood bank with experience in drawing blood samples, performing serological assays like ELISA, Immunohematological tests like blood grouping, cross-matching, Coombs test, etc.

salary_details.project technical support-iii: Rs. 28000/- per month plus HRA @20% i.e Rs. 5600/- = Rs. 33,600/- consolidated per month

selection_process: The selection process includes the shortlisting of applications followed by a Walk-In-Interview for shortlisted candidates.
how_to_apply: Download the application form in the prescribed format from the official notification.
Fill out all required details in the application form accurately.

Type “Application for the post of Project Technical Support-III sanctioned under ICMR project entitled “To determine the frequency of clinically important blood group antigens and risk of alloimmunization in sickle cell disease patients: A multicentric study from India” in the subject line of your email.
Send the filled application form via email to [email protected] on or before 23/10/2026 up to 05.00 PM.
Do not send a hard copy of the application form or documents at this stage.
Wait for communication via email regarding the list of shortlisted candidates and interview details.
important_instructions: The above position will be filled purely on a temporary CONTRACT appointment basis under the ICMR project. Initial contract appointment will normally be for a period of eleven (11) months, extendable depending on the availability of funds from the funding agency. Persons already in regular time scale service under any Government Department/Organization are not eligible to apply. Submission of wrong or false information during the process of selection shall disqualify the candidature at any stage. Contract appointee shall not have any claim on a regular post in this institute or the funding agency. Benefits of Provident Fund, Pension Scheme, Leave Travel Concession, Medical claim, etc., are not admissible. Candidates must produce all original documents and certificates along with one set of self-attested photocopies at the time of joining. The engagement can be terminated at any time by giving one month's notice on either side.
